title: 2.5 This and That
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
unit_outcome: Recognize common surroundings and identify, count, and describe concrete objects without using untaught location language.
lesson_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
goal: Use this for one clearly near object and that for one clearly distant object.
grammar_function: This is a noun for a foreground/held object; That is a noun for an object across the scene. Singular only.
prerequisite: 2.3 object identities and 2.4 What question-answer frame.
speaking_outcome: Repeat three this sentences and three that sentences with clear initial consonants.

cards.pedagogy_note: near cue introduced with foreground hand
far cue introduced with same object
same object; distance is sole variable
Repetition with growth: demonstrative near contrast for phone
Repetition with growth: demonstrative far contrast for chair
Extra practice: This is a book.
singular be agreement in the that frame
Repetition with growth: demonstrative production with near distance
Repetition with growth: demonstrative production with far distance
